podcast.title: "Sabbath-influenced Punk" Description
podcast.body: Thayil personally described Soundgarden's 1988 debut album, "Ultramega OK," as "Sabbath-influenced punk," offering insight into the band's blend of heavy and raw styles. "Guitarist Kim Thales himself described it as, quote, Sabbath-influenced punk."

podcast.title: AC/DC Influence
podcast.body: Kim Thayil, Soundgarden's guitarist, aimed to transform The Ohio Players' funk hit "FOP," which Soundgarden covered, into something that echoed the sound of AC/DC. "Most Kim Thales said he wanted to turn it into something closer to ACDC."
